Rejected — more authoring overhead than the pin-core rule needs

rationale: The product owner needs to archive/reorganize console pages without editing files, while protecting source-of-truth Core Docs from being moved. A section-only write satisfies this without giving the console authority over project state.
summary: Added a per-page section dropdown that moves an item between QuarterDeck sections. New POST /api/item/{id}/section endpoint and pure helpers (legal_target_sections, apply_section_change, write_config) write the item's new section to console.json. Rule: pin core, free elsewhere — Core Docs are pinned; other items move freely among Pages/Plan/Action Items/Archive. The move changes only an item's section, never its type or content.
title: Add QuarterDeck recategorize control (section-only move, pinned core)
